simple.meaning: פֶּרֶץ עֻזָּא (Perets ʻUzzâʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “Perets-Uzza , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: פֶּרֶץ עֻזָּא (H6560) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Samuel 6:8, with occurrences in 2 Samuel, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פֶּרֶץ עֻזָּא (H6560) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in פֶּרֶץ עֻזָּא (H6560) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: פֶּרֶץ עֻזָּא (Perets ʻUzzâʼ) / H6560 is traced through 2 Samuel 6:8, 1 Chronicles 13:11 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
